I have analyzed the failing tests, identified the buggy logic, and deduced the intended behavior.

### Summary of Investigation
* **Failing Tests:** Multiple tests across axis and chart creation suites (e.g., [`LogAxisTests.testXYAutoRange1`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_arch/tests/org/jfree/chart/axis/junit/LogAxisTests.java#L253), [`NumberAxisTests.testXYAutoRange1`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_arch/tests/org/jfree/chart/axis/junit/NumberAxisTests.java#L347), [`XYPlotTests.testDrawRangeGridlines`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_arch/tests/org/jfree/chart/plot/junit/XYPlotTests.java#L1051)) fail with a `NullPointerException` in [`XYPlot.getDataRange`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_arch/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4493).
* **Intended Behavior:** When calculating an axis data range on an [`XYPlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_arch/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java) where a mapped dataset does not have an assigned renderer (or the renderer is `null`), the plot should compute the bounds directly from the dataset without throwing a `NullPointerException`.

The living requirement has been specified in [requirement.feature](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_arch/requirement.feature).
